title: Lookup Owned Keys
goal: Query a HashMap with String keys using a string slice &str.
hints: Rust's HashMap<String, V> allows searching with a &str reference directly.
The .get() method returns Option<&V>, which can be copied and unwrapped with a default.
explanation: scores.get(name) accepts &str directly because String implements Borrow<str>. The get method returns Option<&i32>. copied().unwrap_or(0) converts Option<&i32> safely to i32. Passing &name creates &&str and fails the trait bound. Direct indexing with [name] returns &i32 directly and panics if missing.
